description: This header file contains Google extensions to the standard C++ <algorithm> header, including implementations of functions like equal(), linear_search(), and rotate(), as well as internal comparison structures and helper functions.

classes.name: EqualTo
classes.description: A struct that performs equality comparison using operator==, similar to C++14's std::equal_to<>.

methods.name: EqualImpl
methods.description: Internal implementation of range equality comparison, optimized for iterator categories.

methods.name: equal
methods.description: Public interface to compare two ranges for equality, with or without a custom predicate.

methods.name: linear_search
methods.description: Performs a linear search for a value within a range.

methods.name: rotate
methods.description: Performs a left rotation on a range of elements, returning an iterator to the element that was at the start.
